listing.name: BIGLOGISTICS
listing.aiSummary: Adds extremely large logistics ships, including a massive welded Atlas and an oversized Prometheus.

description: Introduces giant cargo vessels such as the 'Ten Atlases Welded Together' and an 'Extremely Wide Prometheus'. It also includes a normal Starliner variant. Recent updates nerfed sensor ranges to fix weird interactions and adjusted ship descriptions.
